metadata.fxMethod: Arithmetic mean of daily quote/base rates on matching dates. World Bank annual USD means used only where daily data are absent; cross-rates from such annual means are labelled separately. Current year and incomplete historical periods are marked partial. Survey-date dollar_ex is never an annual FX rate.
